content.comment_body: Hello, I am trying to connect to a PLC using the demo version of [product_name] V8. However, I am unable to upload or download because the transfer feature is consistently unavailable, as shown in the attached image. Any advice on how to resolve this?
That is correct. With the demo version, you can only create, modify, and test programs in simulation mode. Communication with an actual device is not possible in the demo.
Which software should I use for full functionality?
You need to purchase an installation DVD for [product_name] to access the complete version. For example, [product_name] V8.4.1 with order number [article_no].

analysis.insight_summary: Users report that the demo version of [product_name] V8 does not allow uploading or downloading to a physical PLC device. The key insight is that demo and full versions differ in capabilities, leading to misunderstandings regarding device communication options.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the demo software to allow connecting and transferring programs to a physical PLC, even when using the demo version.
